messages:
Sara (CS): Hey team — Nimbus Labs flagged a billing mismatch after the billing cycle closed. Invoice shows 2 line items for Nov: `Pro plan - 10k tokens` and `Overage - 43,212 tokens` but dashboard daily export sums to ~31,212 tokens. Can someone triage?
Jordan (Billing): Thanks Sara. Account ID? Do we have the raw invoice PDF and the dashboard export CSV?
Sara (CS): Account: acct_nimbus_42. Attached invoice link: https://redwood/billing/invoices/INV-20231142 (customer provided). I pulled our dashboard CSV for Nov 1-30 from exports -> https://redwood/exports/usage/acct_nimbus_42-nov.csv
Nate (Eng): Curious if this is a classic timezone/cutoff issue. Our billing window is UTC 00:00 - 23:59, dashboard export sometimes uses tenant-local timezone for daily buckets. Will check aggregation code.
Maria (Ops): Also possible double-count on plan migration: they moved from "Starter" -> "Pro" on Nov 15; I remember a spike during the migration script. Could be that some tokens were attributed to both tiers during the transition window.
Jordan (Billing): Invoice line items: 
- Pro plan (prorated): 10,000 tokens included
- Usage overage: 43,212 tokens billed at overage rate
Total tokens billed: 53,212
Dashboard CSV sum (what Sara sent): 31,212 tokens for same period
So missing ~22,000 tokens.
Nate (Eng): Running quick query against raw usage events for acct_nimbus_42:
```
SELECT event_day, SUM(tokens) as tokens_day
FROM usage_events
WHERE account_id = 'acct_nimbus_42' AND ts >= '2023-11-01' AND ts < '2023-12-01'
GROUP BY event_day;
```
I'll paste the per-day totals in a sec. If there are events ingested twice due to retry dedupe bug, that could inflate invoiceable count.
Sara (CS): Customer is adamant — they pay invoices from our portal, but their finance team reconciles to our export. They flagged the extra 22k as unexpected.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-20231142 status: paid. Charge breakdown available at https://redwood/billing/INV-20231142/lines
Maria (Ops): Nate, when you run the query, can you also check the ingestion_id / request_id distribution? Migrations sometimes create new api_key + copy of requests in backfill job.
Nate (Eng): Quick peek: I see ~21,980 tokens attributed to dates Nov 15-16 with request_id pattern `migrate-*`. Looks like the migration backfill re-ingested a subset of historical requests and our dedupe key wasn't set during that job. That explains ~22k discrepancy.
Jordan (Billing): Ok that matches the delta. Two follow-ups from billing: 1) Were those re-ingested events marked as billable? 2) If yes, can we credit the customer or issue an invoice adjustment?
Nate (Eng): They were ingested as normal usage events and flowed to metering. Dedupe only applies to realtime ingestion path, not the bulk backfill because the job used a different ingestion flag. I'll open a PR to add dedupe keys and fix backfill.
Maria (Ops): Immediate mitigation: we can mark the affected ingestion batch as non-billable in the billing DB and emit corrected usage export. That would cause an invoice adjustment. Ops needs the batch id. Nate, can you give me the batch_id?
Nate (Eng): Batch id: backfill_2023-11-15-ops123. I've put a stop on any further backfills.
Jordan (Billing): I'll prepare a credit memo draft for Nimbus: credit ~22,000 tokens worth of overage charges. Need confirmation of final recalculated invoice amount and updated csv for their finance team.
Sara (CS): I'll update the customer that we're investigating and likely issuing a credit. Can you include a short explanation they can give to their finance team? Simple language pls.
Jordan (Billing): Short explanation: "We identified a duplicate ingestion from a backfill operation during a plan migration that caused ~22k tokens to be counted twice. We've voided the erroneous usage records and issued a credit on INV-20231142. Adjusted invoice and updated usage export attached."
Sara (CS): Perfect. I'll send that and attach the corrected CSV when ready. :thumbsup:
billing-bot: Credit memo CM-20231142 created for INV-20231142 amount: $27.34 (overage credit).
Nate (Eng): Follow-up items: 1) Patch backfill dedupe and add validation checks; 2) Add a monitoring alert for large deltas between daily ingestion and meter output; 3) Post-mortem note in #postmortems. I'll file JIRA ENG-5473.
Maria (Ops): Ops will run the non-billable update and regenerate exports. ETA 2 business days.
Jordan (Billing): I'll attach updated invoice & export once Ops confirms. Thanks all.
Sara (CS): Closing loop with customer now. Will drop the convo link in CRM. Thanks everyone.
